arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS users_with_online_transaction, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) AS total_users FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id WHERE t.transaction_type = 'Online Transaction'
arguments.explanation: Counts the distinct users who have made at least one online transaction, alongside the total number of users for context.
assumptions: 'Online transaction' means transactions.transaction_type = 'Online Transaction' (not the merchant location city = 'ONLINE').
Users are linked to transactions through cards.user_id, counting each user once regardless of how many online transactions they made.
All transactions are counted, labelled or not, because the question asks about transactions, not fraud.
The period is the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
